item.title: Ministry of Environment pushes forward with climate resilience initiatives
item.description: The Ministry of Environment, Conservation, Climate Change, Disaster Management and Meteorology (MECCDM) is making strides in reducing the country's dependence on fossil fuels and enhancing climate resilience.
